When `cil_resolve_ast()` subsequently destroys the disabled optional's children, `cil_destroy_classpermissionset()` frees those owned `cil_classperms` objects, leaving dangling entries in the surviving named classpermission. Pre-verification later dereferences one at `__cil_verify_classperms()` in cil_verify.c:1691, causing the heap-use-after-free. The reset must discard/rebuild the named classpermission's borrowed aggregation rather than retain its entries across optional deletion.
